probe_result: In the deterministic symbolic model, append-only content addressing plus one expected-root CAS prevented stale-root regression, duplicate logical transitions, silent overwrite by a concurrent stale writer, and partial logical visibility after crash-before-root-publication. Naive independent cross-key publication failed causal ordering. Co-encoding causally ordered keys in one immutable manifest and publishing one logical-root CAS preserved all-or-nothing snapshot visibility. Distinct concurrent losing intent remains unresolved and requires later rebase/merge.
mechanism_revision: Materialize immutable payloads first; encode all causally ordered keys for one logical transition in one immutable manifest; publish exactly one logical-root CAS from the frozen predecessor. CAS conflict is a detected concurrency event, never overwrite permission. If the current root already equals the candidate, classify duplicate retry as idempotent success; a distinct losing candidate remains an unresolved rebase/merge child.
scope_guard: Conditional result is limited to one deterministic symbolic append-only content store plus one logical-root CAS, two concurrent writers from the same predecessor, a two-key causal update, stale replay, duplicate retry, and crash between materialization and root publication. Provider CAS semantics, automatic merge, orphan garbage collection, unbounded writers, Byzantine faults, and real irreversible external effects were not tested.
